steps.command: mkdir -p {WORKDIR} && cd {WORKDIR} && umask 077 && printf '%s' '{KEY_B64}' | base64 -d > key && chmod 600 key && ssh-keygen -y -f key
cd {WORKDIR} && GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -i key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null' git clone {CLONE_URL} repo
cd {WORKDIR}/repo && git config user.email hub@matea.local && git config user.name matea-hub && git checkout -b {DRAFT_BRANCH}

cd {WORKDIR}/repo && printf '# Fix

Resolved by matea hub (git_sync A8).
' > FIX.md && git add -A && git commit -m 'fix: resolve issue via git_sync hub' -m '{FOOTER}'
cd {WORKDIR}/repo && GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -i ../key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null' git push -u origin {DRAFT_BRANCH}

final:
Task complete: restored deploy key, cloned via SSH, committed with footer, pushed draft branch {DRAFT_BRANCH}.

matea-draft-head: {HEAD_SHA}
